blind.description: A stylised demonic or gothic three-candle candelabra. It features three red wax candles with dripping melted wax and black wicks, seated in ornate golden cups atop a three-branched fixture. The central stem is a spiral-twisted golden column, which terminates in a tripod base made of three dark cloven hooves. Surfaces are solid and smoothly modelled with hand-painted stylized textures. It stands directly on its three hooves without an extra base, and has no active flames or glowing effects.
blind.from_above: Three circular red candle tops with central black wicks aligned in a slight row, surrounded by melted rim details, with the tips of three cloven hooves radiating outward at the base.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 3 feet tall (about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet wide across the candle arms.

notes: Footprint is slightly broader than requested catalog ratio but reads cleanly as a floor candelabra
